prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.5%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 71.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.8%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Move sign-in after pet adoption', 'Compact welcome banner with quick start guide', 'Move sign-in after completion waiting']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Pet preview confirmation screen', 'Post-certificate sign in reorder', 'Story carousel onboarding intro', 'Two column home intro overview', 'Pet companion sound and preview customizer flow', 'Reorder sign in after pet waiting step', 'Spotlight layout for pick friend screen', 'Sign in after waiting state', 'Story scroll layout for home intro screen']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Highlight quick preset vs custom paths', 'Card layout for adoption certificate', 'Redesign final screen into interactive launch stage', 'Desktop pet controls tutorial screen', 'Time estimate badges on path choices', 'Photo upload requirement checklist', 'Split-screen pet adoption studio', 'Starter bonus perk badge', 'Grid pet selection layout', 'Pet companion control tutorial screen', 'Certificate preview before photo upload', 'Guided photo upload helper sub-flow', 'Pet trait guidance hint on friend selection', 'Compact layout for adoption certificate screen', 'Interactive pet naming waiting room screen', 'Account pet retrieval explicit hint', 'Welcome reward badge on home intro', 'Pet trait preview sub-flow', 'Desktop display controls onboarding screen', 'Spotlight adoption seal ceremony', 'Photo lighting photo upload hint', 'Move sign-in to final step after home intro', 'Pet care pledge screen', 'Path selection quiz flow', 'Photo quality setup hint', 'Official pet parent adoption badge', 'Post-adoption certificate account sign in', 'Interactive tip carousel waiting screen redesign', 'Desktop launch readiness check screen', 'Photo source clarity guidance hint', 'Desktop control quick guide home intro redesign', 'Starter pet toy item reward incentive', 'Pet care profile flow', 'Account recovery hint on sign in screen', 'Adoption completion bonus certificate badge', 'Move sign in screen before path selection']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) is helpful, averaging +1.6% after noise correction across 5 tests with 2 wins, though 3 tests showed no clear effect.
Finish redesigns (finish, redesign) are helpful, averaging +1.2% after noise correction across 3 tests with 1 win, though 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for adoption changes (adoption, new_screen; adoption, new_flow; adoption, redesign) with only 1 test each, all showing no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for path choice redesigns (choose_path, redesign) with only 1 test, which showed no clear effect.
Predictions are often too high, overestimating actual noise-corrected impact in most tests.
Predictions can sometimes underestimate actual impact, as seen in round 6 (+1.5% predicted vs +3.0% noise-corrected) and round 7 (+2.2% predicted vs +4.5% noise-corrected).

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Carousel Pet Selector Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pick_friend screen into a full carousel layout featuring pet animation previews to help users select their favorite companion faster.
candidates.why: Adoption is the largest drop-off in the funnel (60.9% conversion), and visual carousel previews help users connect with pets quickly.

candidates.title: Split Layout Adoption Certificate Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a split layout with a prominent pet naming input box.
candidates.why: Making the certificate screen more interactive and clear strengthens emotional commitment during the adoption step.

candidates.title: Move Sign-In Screen Immediately After Pet Selection
candidates.change: Reorder the sign-in screen to occur right after picking a pet companion, securing the choice early before heavy processing steps.
candidates.why: Reordering sign-in has proven effective (+1.6% average lift), and securing pet choice early helps prevent support issues regarding missing/reset pets.

candidates.title: Stage Layout Pet Crafting Waiting Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a dynamic stage layout showcasing an animated pet crafting process.
candidates.why: The waiting step has high latency (mean 2336s). A visually rich stage layout reassures users that custom creation is actively taking place.

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Sync Clarification
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen letting returning users know that signing in will automatically restore their existing pets.
candidates.why: The top support theme (8 emails) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in will sync and restore any existing pets linked to your account.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Generation Quality Sample Hint
candidates.change: Add a photo sample preview component and guidance hint on the photo upload screen demonstrating optimal lighting and angles.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or producing bad results, contributing to adoption step drop-off.

upload_photos.hint: For best generation results, upload bright, front-facing pet photos.

candidates.title: Path Selection Clarity Headline
candidates.change: Update the choose_path screen headline and hint to clearly distinguish between picking a preset pet companion and creating a custom pet.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a long mean drop-off time (514s), indicating hesitation and lack of clarity on path differences.

choose_path.headline: Select How You Want to Create Your Companion
choose_path.hint: Choose a ready-to-play pet or build a custom pet from your own photos.

candidates.title: System Tray Pet Control Guide
candidates.change: Add detailed instructions to the home intro screen explaining how to summon, hide, or manage the pet using the desktop system tray icon.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.

home_intro.body: Your pet now lives on your desktop! Use the system tray icon to summon, hide, or access pet settings at any time.
home_intro.hint: Right-click the tray icon anytime to manage desktop display settings.

candidates.title: Desktop Notification When Pet is Ready
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification readiness alerts during the waiting step so users feel comfortable minimizing the app.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a high mean time of 2336s. Allowing users to safely minimize the window prevents abandonment during pet processing.

waiting.body: Feel free to minimize this window. We will notify you as soon as your pet is ready!

candidates.title: Split Story Desktop Mascot Intro Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the onboarding story intro into a split screen layout featuring a mascot graphic showing the pet resting on a work desktop.
candidates.why: Improving the initial hook sets clear expectations for how desktop pets integrate with daily computer use.

story.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
story.body: Bring your desktop to life with an interactive virtual pet that works alongside you.
